anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
I'm using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace. The caller passed resolved PR values, so I follow `reference/pr-head.md` instead of Steps 0 and 1.

## Resolve and fetch (cwd unchanged throughout)

1. `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir` returns `/work/widget/.git`, so **ROOT=/work/widget**.
2. `git rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` returns empty, so this is not a submodule.
3. The overrides ladder finds no worktree keys and there is no wrapper. Home therefore defaults to `$ROOT/.worktrees/<name>`:
   - `<name>=fix-retry`
   - **WORKTREE=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry**
4. `SYNC=rebase`. Home is #12 on `fix/retry` with `PRE_REWORK_HEAD=aaaa…aaaa`.
5. **MEMBER_HEADS** = [#13 fix/cap bbbb…, #14 fix/retry-docs cccc…].
6. `git -C /work/widget fetch origin` succeeds.
7. Reachability and remote equality, checked for every admitted PR before any write:
   - `git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q aaaa…^{commit}` succeeds, and `git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/retry` equals aaaa….
   - `… bbbb…^{commit}` succeeds, and `origin/fix/cap` equals bbbb….
   - `… cccc…^{commit}` succeeds, and `origin/fix/retry-docs` equals cccc….
   - **Where #14 would fail:** if cccc… were missing or `origin/fix/retry-docs` had moved, I would stop right here. That is after the fetch and before any worktree, file, ref write or checkout. The stop would read: `PR #14 head ccccccc is not reachable (origin/fix/retry-docs is at <sha7>); the branch moved.`
8. `git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/main` gives **BASE_SHA=dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd**.
9. Ordered stops:
   - `isCrossRepository` is false for all three PRs.
   - `git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain` does not list `fix/retry`.
   - Reachability passed in step 7.
   - No local `fix/retry` exists, so the ancestry stop does not apply.
10. Recovery check:
    - No home worktree exists, so the rebase-state path checks are skipped.
    - From ROOT, `git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12` finds no ref.
    - `refs/heads/fix/retry` is absent.
    - Result: no recovery, fresh provisioning.

## Provision the exact head

11. Step 3 clean base: `git -C /work/widget status --porcelain` exits 0 with empty output, so the base is clean.
12. Home is inside ROOT, so I run `git -C /work/widget check-ignore -q .worktrees`. It succeeds, so `.worktrees` is already ignored and nothing is written.
13. `git -C /work/widget worktree add "/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry" fix/retry`. Unique-remote DWIM resolves this as `--track -b fix/retry … origin/fix/retry`.
14. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD` returns aaaa…, which equals home `headRefOid`.
15. Pre-rework refs, written with `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry update-ref …`:
    - `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12 aaaa…`
    - `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-13 bbbb…`
    - `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-14 cccc…`

## Sync: home rebase first, then ordered member replays

All commands below run as `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry …`.

16. last-good = aaaa…
17. `rebase --no-rebase-merges origin/main` gives HEAD=eeee…. last-good = eeee….
18. **#13:**
    - `rebase --no-rebase-merges --onto HEAD dddd… bbbb…` replays from BASE_SHA on a detached HEAD, adding ffff… then 1111….
    - `update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry HEAD` moves `fix/retry` to 1111….
    - `checkout fix/retry`. last-good = 1111….
19. **#14:**
    - `rebase --no-rebase-merges --onto HEAD dddd… cccc…` drops every commit as already applied, leaving detached HEAD at 1111….
    - `update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry HEAD` leaves it at 1111….
    - `checkout fix/retry`. last-good = 1111….
20. Member refs are never touched. `origin/fix/cap` stays at bbbb… and `origin/fix/retry-docs` stays at cccc….
21. `update-ref refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12 HEAD` sets it to 1111….
22. On the sync outcome I read the fetched-base constraints owned by `brainstorming/reference/pr-subject.md`. There were no conflicts, so no helper was dispatched and no scoped tests ran.
23. Validation: `merge-base --is-ancestor refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12 HEAD` exits 0. Original-head ancestry is not asserted against the rebased tip.
24. `log --first-parent --format='%H %P' dddd…..HEAD` shows linear history with single parents and no merges:
    ```
    1111111 ← fffffff ← eeeeeee ← ddddddd (origin/main)
    ```

## Review threads

25. I ran the `reviewThreads` GraphQL query (paginated) once each for `-F o=acme -F r=widget -F n=12`, `n=13` and `n=14`. All three returned empty, so the result is `Threads: none` for each.

Nothing was pushed or closed. No spec or plan was written.

## Step 4 report

```
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#12
Pre-rework head: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#13
Pre-rework head: bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
PR: acme/widget#14
Pre-rework head: cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
Base SHA: ddddddd
Rework base: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
Base: main @ ddddddd - rebased: aaaaaaa..1111111, 0 stop(s)
Member replay: #13 fffffff..1111111
Member replay: #14 empty
Threads: #12 none, #13 none, #14 none
Ready to implement the retry-cap rework (acme/widget#12 with #13, #14)
```

MEMBER_HEADS, which still holds the original heads bbbb… and cccc…, is carried forward to gather.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
I'm using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.

All commands below are synthetic, in execution order. **Every command runs with cwd `/work/widget`; the process cwd never changes.** Shell variables in commands expand to the exact values recorded below.

### 1. Resolve the PR worktree contract

The caller supplied PR values, so I follow the PR-head procedure instead of generic Steps 0–1.

```bash
git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir
git rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree
```

Resolved: common directory `/work/widget/.git`; no superproject; `ROOT=/work/widget`.

Inspect overrides in precedence order:

```bash
for p in .pi/gauntlet-overrides.md gauntlet-overrides.md doc/gauntlet-overrides.md; do if [ -f "$p" ]; then cat "$p"; break; fi; done
```

No applicable worktree override or wrapper exists. No conflict runner is needed on this successful, conflict-free path.

Resolved values:

- `BRANCH=fix/retry`, `NAME=fix-retry`
- `WORKTREE=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`
- `SYNC=rebase`, base branch `main`
- `PRE_REWORK_HEAD=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`
- Members, in order: #13 `fix/cap` at `bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`; #14 `fix/retry-docs` at `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`.

### 2. Fetch and validate before writes

```bash
git -C "$ROOT" fetch origin
git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --verify -q aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa^{commit}
git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse origin/fix/retry
git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --verify -q bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb^{commit}
git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse origin/fix/cap
git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --verify -q cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc^{commit}
git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse origin/fix/retry-docs
git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse origin/main
```

All original objects exist; remote tips equal their supplied heads. Resolve `BASE_SHA=dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`.

**The unreachable/moved-#14 stop belongs here, before checkout or any worktree/ref/file write.** It would name #14’s original `ccccccc` head, the observed remote tip, and state that the branch moved. This case passes.

All PRs are in-repository. Check branch occupancy and recovery refs:

```bash
git -C "$ROOT" worktree list --porcelain
git -C "$ROOT" for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)' refs/heads/fix/retry refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12 refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/
```

No conflicting worktree, local home branch, or recovery state exists. There is no existing home tree requiring rebase-state inspection.

### 3. Provision the exact home head

```bash
git -C "$ROOT" status --porcelain
git -C "$ROOT" check-ignore -q .worktrees
```

Source is clean; the ignore check succeeds, so no `.gitignore` write or commit is needed.

Setting up the selected worktree at `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry` on existing PR branch `fix/retry`.

```bash
git -C "$ROOT" worktree add "$WORKTREE" fix/retry
git -C "$ROOT" worktree list --porcelain
git -C "$WORKTREE" rev-parse HEAD
```

Unique-remote DWIM creates the tracking branch. The list confirms the exact selected path; HEAD equals `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`.

Record original provenance:

```bash
git -C "$WORKTREE" update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12 aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
git -C "$WORKTREE" update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-13 bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
git -C "$WORKTREE" update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-14 cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
```

### 4. Rebase home, then replay members in order

Save last-good home SHA as the original `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`.

```bash
git -C "$WORKTREE" rebase --no-rebase-merges origin/main
git -C "$WORKTREE" rev-parse HEAD
```

Success: last-good becomes `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee`.

Replay #13 from the fetched base, temporarily detached:

```bash
git -C "$WORKTREE" rebase --no-rebase-merges --onto HEAD "$BASE_SHA" bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
git -C "$WORKTREE" log --reverse --first-parent --format=%H eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee..HEAD
git -C "$WORKTREE" update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry HEAD
git -C "$WORKTREE" checkout fix/retry
git -C "$WORKTREE" rev-parse HEAD
```

Added commits: `ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff`, then `1111111111111111111111111111111111111111`. Last-good becomes the latter.

Replay #14, again temporarily detached:

```bash
git -C "$WORKTREE" rebase --no-rebase-merges --onto HEAD "$BASE_SHA" cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
git -C "$WORKTREE" log --reverse --first-parent --format=%H 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111..HEAD
git -C "$WORKTREE" update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry HEAD
git -C "$WORKTREE" checkout fix/retry
git -C "$WORKTREE" rev-parse HEAD
```

All #14 commits drop as already applied; the range is empty. Home remains `1111111111111111111111111111111111111111`.

Persist and validate:

```bash
git -C "$WORKTREE" update-ref refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12 HEAD
git -C "$WORKTREE" merge-base --is-ancestor refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12 HEAD
```

Validation succeeds. First-parent history is linear: `ddddddd → eeeeeee → fffffff → 1111111`. Original-head ancestry is not asserted against rebased history. Member branches remain unchanged.

### 5. Fetch unresolved threads

Set the exact GraphQL query:

```bash
Q='query($o:String!,$r:String!,$n:Int!,$endCursor:String){repository(owner:$o,name:$r){pullRequest(number:$n){reviewThreads(first:100,after:$endCursor){pageInfo{hasNextPage endCursor} nodes{id isResolved isOutdated path line originalLine comments(first:100){pageInfo{hasNextPage endCursor} totalCount nodes{url body author{login} createdAt}}}}}}}'
gh api graphql --paginate -f query="$Q" -F o=acme -F r=widget -F n=12
gh api graphql --paginate -f query="$Q" -F o=acme -F r=widget -F n=13
gh api graphql --paginate -f query="$Q" -F o=acme -F r=widget -F n=14
```

Each synthetic fetch succeeds empty: `Threads: none`.

### Step 4 report

```text
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#12
Pre-rework head: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#13
Pre-rework head: bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
PR: acme/widget#14
Pre-rework head: cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
Base SHA: ddddddd
Rework base: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
Member replay: #13 fffffff..1111111
Member replay: #14 empty
Base: main @ ddddddd - rebased: aaaaaaa..1111111, 0 stop(s) in none
Threads: none
Ready to implement retry caps
```

No push, close, spec, plan, or additional test commands run.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Before read pr-head.md's "Advance by merge… Never git rebase" as overriding the caller's SYNC=rebase, so it narrated member-then-base merges, never wrote pre-rework or rework-base refs, asserted original-head ancestry against HEAD, and emitted a merge-only report; that failed order, ancestry, and report while preflight already held. After delivers the Change cleanly: home is rebased with --no-rebase-merges onto origin/main first, #13 and #14 are replayed in listed order via `rebase --no-rebase-merges --onto HEAD BASE_SHA <original head>` on detached HEAD, `update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry HEAD` plus `checkout fix/retry` follow each success, origin member branches stay at bbbb…/cccc…, rework-base is persisted at 1111… and its ancestry (not the original heads') is validated, and the report lists all three PR/Pre-rework pairs home first with the full Rework base directly after Base SHA, the rebased range, and both Member replay lines. The preflight stop for a moved/unreachable #14 is still placed after fetch and before any worktree, ref write or checkout, so nothing regressed. No wording change is needed; if anything, keep the explicit sentence that SYNC=rebase for PR subjects supersedes pr-head.md's merge-only rule (or state that pr-head.md's rebase path applies) so a future reader does not reintroduce Before's refusal.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After moves order, ancestry, and report from fails to holds while keeping preflight, which was the only fact Before satisfied: Before refused the SYNC=rebase workflow as incompatible with merge-preservation rules and stopped before checkout, so it never rebased home, replayed members, wrote pre-rework/rework-base refs, or emitted a Step 4 report. After performs the full sequence the Change describes — fetch and per-head object/remote-equality checks before any write, the #14 stop explicitly located before checkout and naming ccccccc, home rebase with --no-rebase-merges onto origin/main, then each member replayed detached via `rebase --no-rebase-merges --onto HEAD BASE_SHA <original head>` followed by update-ref on refs/heads/fix/retry and checkout, pre-rework refs for all three heads, rework-base written at 1111… and validated with merge-base --is-ancestor instead of original-head ancestry, origin member branches left untouched, and a home-first report with full Pre-rework heads, both Member replay lines, rebased: aaaaaaa..1111111, and the full Rework base directly after Base SHA. Nothing regressed; the wording that makes rebase the default PR-subject sync (rather than a conflict with merge-preservation rules) is what unlocked the moved facts, and the explicit 'name #14, before checkout or any ref/file write' sentence is what preserved preflight — keep both.
